entries.title: Psalms 141:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> LORD, I cry out to You; Make haste to me! Give ear to my voice when I cry out to You.

entries.title: Psalms 141:2
segments: Let my prayer be set before You [as] incense, The lifting up of my hands [as] the evening sacrifice.

entries.title: Psalms 141:3
segments: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; Keep watch over the door of my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 141:4
segments: Do not incline my heart to any evil thing, To practice wicked works With men who work iniquity; And do not let me eat of their delicacies.

entries.title: Psalms 141:5
segments: ¶Let the righteous strike me; [It shall be] a kindness. And let him rebuke me; [It shall be] as excellent oil; Let my head not refuse it. For still my prayer [is] against the deeds of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 141:6
segments: Their judges are overthrown by the sides of the cliff, And they hear my words, for they are sweet.

entries.title: Psalms 141:7
segments: Our bones are scattered at the mouth of the grave, As when one plows and breaks up the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 141:8
segments: But my eyes [are] upon You, O GOD the Lord; In You I take refuge; Do not leave my soul destitute.

entries.title: Psalms 141:9
segments: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, And from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 141:10
segments: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, While I escape safely.
